title: SQL SUM() Function
text:
SQL
SUM()
Function



The SQL SUM() Function

The
SUM()
function is used to calculate the total sum of values within a specified numeric column.

The
SUM()
function ignores NULL values in the column.

The following SQL returns the sum of the Quantity field in the "OrderDetails" table:

SUM() Syntax

SELECT SUM(
column_name
)
FROM
table_name
WHERE
condition
;
